headline: APEC business summit begins work in Shenzhen, China
summary: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation business summit has begun in Shenzhen, China, gathering more than 2,000 representatives. The forum brings together business leaders from APEC member economies.
why: APEC is a forum of Asia-Pacific economies that sets trade and investment cooperation agendas, which shape cross-border trade and investment flows.
original_headline: В китайском Шэньчжэне начал свою работу деловой саммит АТЭС
